TESVOLT TALLON: from 2.5 MW
MORE STABILITY. MORE YIELD. MORE FUTURE.

In times of rising energy prices and growing demands on grid stability, battery parks are becoming more than ever the economic backbone of the energy transition. Our new TESVOLT TALLON battery container provides the ideal basis for this thanks to its particularly durable cell chemistry, high cycle stability and permanently stable operating costs.

Whether for electricity trading, control power or grid stability , the TALLON combines maximum economic efficiency with exceptional service life, making it a central component of sustainable, future-proof storage projects.

Application	2 h / 0,5 CP
Storage capacity per container	5,015 MWh
Maximum performance	2,5 MW
Cell chemistry	LFP

Future-proof platform with leading storage technology and global technology focus

Continuous operation with minimal downtime (10 minutes) thanks to efficient cooling plate design

One, two or more DC outputs per container – ideal for flexible connection to multiple inverters or hybrid setups

Multi-stage fire protection concept with module-to-cell detection, active gas venting, aerosol extinguishing systems, bursting discs and fire brigade connection

Quick installation and commissioning

TESVOLT ENERGY CONTROLLER PRO

The standard-compliant battery park manager with EZA controller for maximum safety and connectivity

Safety, reliability and cost-effectiveness are essential for the implementation and operation of large battery storage systems in energy trading. With the TESVOLT Energy Controller Pro, we offer you a customized and comprehensive battery park management system. In addition to minimal planning and implementation effort, the TESVOLT Energy Controller Pro guarantees the best connectivity with maximum safety and reliability thanks to high-quality components.

Complete battery park management including EZA control

The TESVOLT Energy Controller Pro is a secure solution for the control, communication, system protection and EZA control of large battery storage systems. Among other things, it features an intelligent battery park controller as well as interfaces for marketing, monitoring and service, in compliance with the highest safety standards.

WHAT MAKES A GOOD LARGE-CAPACITY STORAGE DEVICE?

Keep your eyes open when buying a storage system

Anyone investing in a battery park expects maximum performance with the lowest possible operating costs. To ensure that this pays off, it is worth taking a close look at the storage quality - because not every large-scale storage system delivers what it promises.

 Usable capacity: 100% depth of discharge, meaning that storage systems can be designed smaller, resulting in lower investment costs.

 High warranty coverage: Product and performance warranty for cells up to 20 years, up to 11,000 cycles to SOH 60%

 High system availability: 98% availability guarantee, only 10 minutes of downtime required in the operating cycle.

 System flexibility thanks to modular concept: High system flexibility with one, two or more DC outputs per container for optimal distribution from EES to PCS

POWERCORE G2: from 250 kW
POWERCORE G2. BATTERY STORAGE FROM 500 KWH FOR INDUSTRY AND SMALL UTILITIES

Cost-efficient hardware, TESVOLT safety standards, and smart IoT-based system logic — optimized for long-term revenues in energy trading as well as for optimization and savings through energy management.

It is a proven product with many years of real-world experience. With over 1,000 systems installed worldwide, it is built on a system architecture that has successfully demonstrated its reliability in real projects and across different markets.

The PowerCore G2 battery storage system is suitable for larger commercial & industrial projects starting from 500 kWh as well as small utility projects in the multi-MWh range.

 

 

 

TESVOLT'S SUCCESS FORMULA
Low investment costs, high returns.

Strong and long-term economic performance — achieved either through Energy Trading from 50 kW upward or through classic storage applications.

Intelligent software and service environment

Secure and stable system operation throughout the entire lifecycle. Digital, integrated, and scalable.

Cost-efficient Tier-1 hardware

Reliable systems in verified quality. TESVOLT-approved components for maximum operational safety.

WHO BENEFITS MOST FROM THIS OFFERING?
Customers and investors focused on energy trading
Users who need high power and/or capacity for classic outdoor storage applications
Projects where price-performance, fast implementation, and high returns are decisive
Commercial and industrial customers with C&I projects from 500 kWh and Small Utility projects over 3 MWh
IN FOCUS: EXCELLENT ECONOMICS OF THE POWERCORE G2
with energy trading (flexibility marketing)
with energy optimization (classic applications)

TESVOLT Energy aggregates and controls battery storage systems into a Virtual Power Plant and markets their flexibility on the electricity market, enabling companies to generate predictable revenues from market volatility.

By monetizing the flexibility needed for the energy transition, this unlocks what is currently the largest untapped return potential for businesses and investors today.

The TESVOLT Energy Management System enables operational energy optimization through efficient battery management — for example for self-consumption optimization, peak shaving, and similar applications.

Individually configurable operating strategies make it possible to flexibly combine different applications and precisely tailor the system to the needs of commercial and industrial users.

With TESVOLT Energy, your battery storage system becomes an investable asset that actively generates revenue.
You continuously reduce operating costs, significantly shortening the payback period of your system.

POWERCORE-G2– COMPLIANT GRID INTEGRATION IN GERMANY

with TESVOLT Energy Controller Pro S

TESVOLT FORTON is ready for grid integration

Connection to a higher-level master EZA controller via the TESVOLT Energy Controller Pro S (TEC Pro S)
TEC Pro S enables control, communication, and integration of the storage system
Ensures VDE-AR-N 4110-compliant grid integration (compatible master EZA controller required)
List of recommended compatible EZA controllers and Modbus integration available on request
CONFIGURATION OPTIONS

For 6 and more PC-G2 units operating in parallel, transformers for galvanic isolation are required.

SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE OF POWERCORE G2

At the grid connection point, the energy flow is measured via a current measuring coil and an energy meter. These measurements form the basis for the intelligent control of the entire system.

Via a customer-provided router and a central network switch, all components are digitally connected. The core of the system is the TESVOLT Energy Manager — it acts as the conductor of the system.

Device architecture: Each PowerCore G2 is connected through a TESVOLT IoT Gateway . The battery storage and inverter sit logically behind this gateway and communicate with the TESVOLT Energy Manager via adapters or a Modbus interface.

This ensures that every individual asset is cleanly integrated, standardized in its data, and remotely controllable.

Role of the TESVOLT Energy Manager:

the system logic — the decision-making intelligence,
the orchestration of all storage systems,
the multi-asset operation of several PowerCore G2 units as one coordinated overall system.

Frontend and cloud: The overarching user interface — monitoring, portals, and trading connection in the cloud — remains identical to the TESVOLT FORTON architecture. This means: the same user experience, the same tools, with a new hardware topology underneath.
